newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee firms on dollar after intervention.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee firms on dollar after intervention.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee was fixed firmer against the dollar on Thursday, reflecting central bank support of the local currency on Wednesday, forex dealers said.
The rupee was fixed at a mean commercial rate of 20.0490 for one dollar on Thursday from 20.0965 on Wednesday. Against stg, the rupee weakened to a mean of 33.6725 from 33.6325 on Wednesday.
Dealers said the central bank sold dollars to commercial banks on Wednesday early afternoon with the intervention rate a few cents lower than the prevailing interbank rate.

"This (intervention) offset the dollar's appreciation in overseas market and the rupee was today fixed firmer against major currencies such as German mark, French franc and Japanese yen," a dealer said.
